title: CaptureBundle
description: The output of a single Playwright capture run: screenshots, page model, and environment fingerprint.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Semver-like schema version. '1.1' adds optional hitTests, pseudoElements, pseudoTruncated top-level fields and optional settle/quiescence determinism keys (all additive; 1.0 documents still validate against the required set).

capturedAt.title: Captured at
capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the bundle was written. Excluded from golden comparisons.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.description: The browser viewport configuration used for this capture.

name.title: Viewport name
name.description: Logical name for this viewport, e.g. 'desktop' or 'mobile'.

dsf.title: Device scale factor
dsf.description: Device pixel ratio. 1 means CSS px == PNG px.

environment.title: Environment fingerprint
environment.description: Records the rendering environment so cross-machine comparison can be flagged.

os.title: Operating system
os.description: Value of process.platform at capture time (e.g. 'linux', 'darwin', 'win32').

playwright.title: Playwright version
playwright.description: The exact Playwright package version used.

dsf.title: Device scale factor
dsf.description: Device pixel ratio recorded in the environment fingerprint.

determinism.title: Determinism record
determinism.description: Records the status of every stabilization step so analyze can lower confidence for failed/skipped steps.

animationsDisabled.title: Animations disabled
animationsDisabled.description: Status of the animation/transition kill CSS injection step.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Status of the emulateMedia reducedMotion step.

timeFrozen.title: Time frozen
timeFrozen.description: Status of the clock.install freezeTime step.

randomStubbed.title: Random stubbed
randomStubbed.description: Status of the Math.random LCG seed injection step.

fontsReady.title: Fonts ready
fontsReady.description: Status of the document.fonts.ready wait step.

imagesDecoded.title: Images decoded
imagesDecoded.description: Status of the visible img decode() pass step.

lazyLoadPass.title: Lazy load pass
lazyLoadPass.description: Status of the scroll-to-bottom lazy load pass step.

settled.title: Settled
settled.description: Status of the clock.runFor(settleMs) settle step.

settle.title: Settle pass
settle.description: Status of the evolved settle stage (viewport-height scroll steps + quiescence wait). Optional; absent on pre-1.1 bundles and when the settle stage did not run (e.g. --no-settle legacy path).

hitTestProbe.title: Hit-test probe
hitTestProbe.description: Status of the per-node clickable-area hit-test probe. Optional; absent on pre-1.1 bundles and when the probe did not run.

quiescence.title: Quiescence
quiescence.description: Outcome of the settle stage's MutationObserver quiescence wait. 'notRun' when the settle stage did not reach the quiescence phase (skipped/failed/legacy). Optional; absent on pre-1.1 bundles.

settleScrollIneffective.title: Settle scroll ineffective
settleScrollIneffective.description: True when the settle stage's scroll steps never moved scrollY (e.g. transform-based scroll containers), so settle recorded 'ran' without asserting real progress. Optional; absent when not evaluated.

settleGrowthCapped.title: Settle growth capped
settleGrowthCapped.description: True when the settle stage's page-growth cap (~3x initial height or max steps) was hit during scroll-through, e.g. an infinite feed. Optional; absent when not evaluated.

clicked.title: Clicked selectors
clicked.description: List of clickBeforeCapture selectors that were successfully clicked.

hidden.title: Hidden selectors
hidden.description: List of hideSelectors that were applied.

masked.title: Masked selectors
masked.description: List of maskSelectors that were applied.

retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.title: Retried without time freeze
retriedWithoutTimeFreeze.description: True if networkidle timed out with freezeTime on and the page was retried without it.

integrity.title: Integrity inventory
integrity.description: Pre/post-stabilization page element counts. Absent when the inventory evaluate failed or was not taken.

page.title: Page model
page.description: Extracted page content, metadata, network log, and console output.

redirectChain.title: Redirect chain
redirectChain.description: List of intermediate redirect URLs, with sensitive params redacted.

statusCode.title: HTTP status code
statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the main document response.

title.title: Page title
title.description: The document title, length-capped and control-char-stripped.

metaDescription.title: Meta description
metaDescription.description: Content of <meta name=description>, or empty string if absent.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.description: Content of <link rel=canonical href=...>, or null if absent.

lang.title: Document language
lang.description: Value of <html lang>, or empty string if absent.

nodes.title: Semantic node stream
nodes.description: Ordered list of visible, meaningful elements extracted in document order.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.description: List of ARIA landmark roles present on the page.

network.title: Network log
network.description: Recorded network requests with sensitive data redacted.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: List of network requests made during page load.

url.title: Request URL
url.description: The request URL with sensitive query params redacted.

status.title: HTTP status
status.description: HTTP response status code, or 0 if failed/no response.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: True if the request failed at the network level.

console.title: Console messages
console.description: Browser console messages captured during page load.

level.title: Log level
level.description: Console message level: log, info, warn, error, debug.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.description: Accessibility audit results. Violations array is empty in M1.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Array of axe-core violations. Empty in M1.

linkProbes.title: Link probes
linkProbes.description: Results of probing same-site links extracted from the page. Always present; empty array when probing is disabled or no candidates exist. Sorted ascending by 'url' (byte order), deduped.

landmarkRects.title: Landmark rects
landmarkRects.description: Bounding boxes for landmark elements and direct children of main that give section-level geometry. Additive optional field; absent in pre-WP-G bundles. Capped at 64 entries.

computedStyles.title: Computed styles
computedStyles.description: Map of node id (node_N) or ancestor id (anc_N) to computed style properties. Empty object in M1; populated in M4.

styleCandidates.title: Style candidates
styleCandidates.description: Metadata describing the computed-style candidate set: ancestor descriptors, per-node ancestor chains, and budget tracking.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Paths to captured screenshots, relative to the bundle file's parent directory (the outDir).

fullPage.title: Full page screenshot
fullPage.description: Path to the full-page PNG, relative to outDir. E.g. 'desktop/old.png'.

viewport.title: Viewport screenshot
viewport.description: Path to the viewport-only PNG, relative to outDir. E.g. 'desktop/old-vp.png'.

hitTests.title: Hit-test probe results
hitTests.description: Map of SemanticNode id to per-node clickable-area hit-test outcomes. Additive optional field (1.1); absent when the hit-test probe did not run (pre-1.1 bundles, or --no-settle-adjacent skip paths).

pseudoElements.title: Pseudo-element entries
pseudoElements.description: Map of owner key to captured ::before/::after entries. Additive optional field (1.1); absent when the pseudo-element scan did not run (pre-1.1 bundles).

pseudoTruncated.title: Pseudo-element truncation
pseudoTruncated.description: Present only when the pseudo-element budget was exceeded and some entries were dropped.

IntegrityCounts.title: IntegrityCounts
IntegrityCounts.description: Counts of selected element types in the page at a point in time.

headingCount.title: Heading count
headingCount.description: Number of h1, h2, h3 elements present in the document.

imageCount.title: Image count
imageCount.description: Number of img elements present in the document.

landmarkCount.title: Landmark count
landmarkCount.description: Number of landmark elements (header, nav, main, footer, aside, and elements with ARIA landmark roles) present in the document.

IntegrityInventory.title: IntegrityInventory
IntegrityInventory.description: Pre/post-stabilization element count snapshots. Used to detect stabilizer-induced DOM mutations.

pre.title: Pre-stabilization counts
pre.description: Element counts taken right after navigation settles, before lazy-load and scroll steps.

post.title: Post-stabilization counts
post.description: Element counts taken after the full stabilization pipeline completes.

LandmarkRect.title: LandmarkRect
LandmarkRect.description: Bounding box and metadata for a single landmark element or a direct child section/div-with-id inside main, captured at the time of extraction.

path.title: Path
path.description: Role-based path identifying this entry. Landmark elements use the role name (e.g. 'main', 'contentinfo'); repeated roles are suffixed '[2]', '[3]', etc. Main's children use 'main › section[N]'.

role.title: Role
role.description: ARIA landmark role for this element.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Text of the first h1-h3 inside this element, trimmed and capped at 80 chars. Null if none found.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Bounding box in page coordinates [x, y, width, height] with scroll offsets added. Values rounded to integers.

AncestorDescriptor.title: AncestorDescriptor
AncestorDescriptor.description: Descriptor for a true ancestor element (a DOM element that is not itself a SemanticNode) included in the computed-style candidate set.

id.title: Ancestor id
id.description: Stable identifier in the form 'anc_<N>', assigned in document order over the deduped true-ancestor set.

tag.title: Tag name
tag.description: Lowercase HTML tag name of this ancestor element.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Bounding box in page coordinates [x, y, width, height]. x/y floored, w/h ceiled. Same convention as SemanticNode.bbox.

depth.title: DOM depth
depth.description: Distance from the document root (documentElement). Used for budget drop order (deepest dropped first).

cssSelector.title: CSS selector
cssSelector.description: Landmark-relative CSS selector for internal re-find use only.

anchors.title: Anchors
anchors.description: Anchor set for this ancestor. text may be inherited from a single contained text-bearing semantic node (M4 §4b item 2); role/href/alt/ariaLabel are always null for container elements.

nearestHeading.title: Nearest heading
nearestHeading.description: Text of the first heading element contained within this ancestor in document order; if none, falls back to the preceding-heading rule; else null.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: ARIA landmark role of the nearest enclosing landmark (itself if it is a landmark element).

ordinalInLandmark.title: Ordinal in landmark
ordinalInLandmark.description: 1-based document-order index of this ancestor among ancestor candidates sharing the same landmark.

StyleCandidates.title: StyleCandidates
StyleCandidates.description: Metadata about the computed-style candidate set captured alongside computedStyles.

ancestors.title: Ancestor descriptors
ancestors.description: Descriptors for true ancestor elements (those not already represented as SemanticNodes), sorted by document order (ascending anc_N id).

chains.title: Ancestor chains
chains.description: Per SemanticNode: ordered list of ancestor ids (node_N or anc_N), nearest ancestor first, furthest (landmark or body) last. Dropped ancestor ids are omitted. Keys are in node-id (document) order.

budget.title: Style budget
budget.description: Maximum number of computedStyles entries allowed. Default 2000.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True if the ancestor set was truncated because the total candidate count exceeded the budget.

droppedCount.title: Dropped count
droppedCount.description: Number of ancestor entries dropped due to budget overflow.

LinkProbe.title: LinkProbe
LinkProbe.description: The result of probing a single same-site link extracted from the page. Records whether the link was fetched, skipped, or errored, along with any redirect chain followed.

url.title: URL
url.description: The absolute, fragment-stripped, redacted URL that was probed.

redirectChain.title: Redirect chain
redirectChain.description: One entry per redirect hop (pre-redirect URLs). Empty when no redirects were followed. Same semantics as page.redirectChain.

finalUrl.title: Final URL
finalUrl.description: The URL of the final (non-redirect) response, redacted. Null when the probe was skipped or errored before receiving any response.

status.title: HTTP status code
status.description: The HTTP status code of the final response. Null when skipped or errored.

skipped.title: Skipped reason
skipped.description: The reason the probe was not fetched, or null when the probe was attempted.

error.title: Error message
error.description: Error message when the probe failed (timeout, connection refused, DNS failure, etc.). Null on success or when skipped.

SemanticNode.title: SemanticNode
SemanticNode.description: A visible, meaningful element extracted from the page in document order.

role.title: ARIA role
role.description: The effective ARIA role of this element, or null.

text.title: Visible text
text.description: Normalized innerText of this element, length-capped.

accName.title: Accessible name
accName.description: Accessible name: aria-label || alt || normalized innerText.

href.title: Href
href.description: Absolute resolved href for links, or null.

imageAlt.title: Image alt text
imageAlt.description: Alt attribute value for images, or null.

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Bounding box in page coordinates [x, y, width, height] with scroll offsets added. x/y floored, w/h ceiled.

anchors.title: Anchor set
anchors.description: The agent-facing locator fingerprint for this node.

text.title: Text anchor
text.description: Normalized visible text, strongest grep target when present.

href.title: Href anchor
href.description: Absolute resolved href, grep target for links.

alt.title: Alt anchor
alt.description: Image alt text, grep target for images.

nearestHeading.title: Nearest heading
nearestHeading.description: Text of the most recent heading node in document order before this node.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: ARIA landmark role of the nearest landmark ancestor: banner|navigation|main|contentinfo|complementary|form.

ordinalInLandmark.title: Ordinal in landmark
ordinalInLandmark.description: 1-based count of nodes with the same (kind, anchors.text) in the same landmark including self. Null if no landmark.

cssSelector.title: CSS selector
cssSelector.description: Landmark-relative CSS selector for internal re-find use only. Not the agent-facing identifier.

rawHref.title: Raw href
rawHref.description: For link nodes: the href attribute exactly as authored (control-char-stripped, length-capped). Null for all other kinds.

src.title: Image src
src.description: For image nodes: currentSrc or src resolved to an absolute URL. Null for all other kinds.

naturalWidth.title: Natural width
naturalWidth.description: For image nodes: intrinsic width in pixels (img.naturalWidth). Null for all other kinds.

naturalHeight.title: Natural height
naturalHeight.description: For image nodes: intrinsic height in pixels (img.naturalHeight). Null for all other kinds.

loaded.title: Image loaded
loaded.description: For image nodes: true when img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0. Null for all other kinds.

headingLevel.title: Heading level
headingLevel.description: For heading nodes: the numeric level 1–6 parsed from the h1–h6 tag. Null for all other kinds.

HitTestEntry.title: HitTestEntry
HitTestEntry.description: Per-node clickable-area hit-test result for one interactive SemanticNode.

status.title: Status
status.description: 'sampled' when the 5x5 grid was probed; 'skipped' when the node was too small, off-document, or detached.

skipReason.title: Skip reason
skipReason.description: Why the node was not sampled. Required when status is 'skipped'.

gridSize.title: Grid size
gridSize.description: The N in the NxN sampling grid (always 5 in this revision). Required when status is 'sampled'.

points.title: Grid points
points.description: 25 entries, row-major from top-left. Required when status is 'sampled'. Coordinates are never stored, only per-point outcomes.

HitTestPoint.title: HitTestPoint
HitTestPoint.description: The outcome of a single grid point probed via elementFromPoint. Coordinates are never stored — only the outcome (and, for a miss, the winning element's selector).

o.title: Outcome
o.description: 'hit' (node/descendant/labeled-control), 'miss' (a different element won), 'clipped' (the winner is an ancestor of the target — rounded/smaller rendering, not occlusion), or 'offViewport' (the point could not be brought on-screen).

winner.title: Winner selector
winner.description: Landmark-relative CSS selector of the element elementFromPoint returned. Required when o is 'miss'.

PseudoStyles.title: PseudoStyles
PseudoStyles.description: Curated computed styles for a single ::before/::after pseudo-element, plus a best-effort bounding box.

content.title: Content
content.description: Resolved value of the CSS content property (quotes/escapes preserved as computed).

bbox.title: Bounding box
bbox.description: Best-effort [x, y, width, height] in page coordinates. Absent when unresolvable.

PseudoElementEntry.title: PseudoElementEntry
PseudoElementEntry.description: A captured ::before and/or ::after pair for a single owner element, keyed by owner key in the top-level pseudoElements map.

ownerTier.title: Owner tier
ownerTier.description: 'node' (owner is a SemanticNode, aligned via old_to_new_id), 'ancestor' (owner is an AncestorDescriptor), or 'selector' (owner is a decorative leaf identified by a landmark-scoped stable selector).

ownerNodeId.title: Owner node id
ownerNodeId.description: SemanticNode id of the owner. Required when ownerTier is 'node'.

ownerSelector.title: Owner selector
ownerSelector.description: Landmark-scoped CSS selector identifying the owner. Required when ownerTier is 'ancestor' or 'selector'.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: ARIA landmark role nearest the owner, or null when the owner has no enclosing landmark.

PseudoTruncated.title: PseudoTruncated
PseudoTruncated.description: Present only when the per-page pseudo-element budget was exceeded.

droppedCount.title: Dropped count
droppedCount.description: Number of pseudo-element entries dropped due to budget overflow.
